name: Slop Detector
description: Score any landing page against the AI-design-slop fingerprint. Deterministic, weighted 0-100 scoring on real headless Chromium, plus an AEO axis (can AI engines read & cite a page). Open source, MIT.

skills.name: Scan page for design slop
skills.description: Open a URL in headless Chromium and score it 0-100 against the deterministic AI-design-slop fingerprint. Optionally score the copy axis.

skills.name: Check AEO readability
skills.description: Score whether AI engines (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews) can fetch, read and cite a page. Higher is better.
examples: Can ChatGPT read and cite https://example.com?

skills.name: Check design-system compliance
skills.description: Check whether a page honors its own declared design system (a DESIGN.md file). Returns a 0-100 compliance score (higher is better) plus named drift: undeclared fonts, off-palette CTA colors, off-scale corner radii.
examples: Does https://example.com still match its DESIGN.md?

skills.name: Build a de-slop fix prompt
skills.description: Generate a ready-to-paste prompt that tells a coding agent how to fix the slop patterns found on a page.
examples: Give me a prompt to fix the slop on https://example.com
